Canonical multiplatform project home; includes Fabric/Forge distributions
Official CurseForge distribution linked by upstream
notes: The initial name-only canonical probe identified five direct label matches and four apparent gaps. The bounded ID-freshness gate then proved all four proposed slugs already existed in the sealed 987/672 registry.

Run 34006157808 semantically verified that the existing iris, c2me, terra, and terralith cards match the intended upstream project lineages; the provider URL collision gate also passed with zero cross-canonical collisions.

Therefore Chunk 31 resolves all nine source mentions to existing canonical families: 9 reuse / 0 new. These 14 provider URLs are retained as research evidence only and are not promoted as a redundant provider closure.

Iris is pinned to IrisShaders/Iris; C2ME to RelativityMC/C2ME-fabric / ishland lineage; Terra to PolyhedralDev/Terra; Terralith to Stardust Labs. Forks, addons, reuploads, and unrelated same-name projects remain excluded.
